description: This file contains configuration utilities for environment variable handling related to database setup in an e-commerce platform. It defines functions to retrieve the database URL and SQL echo setting from environment variables.

methods.name: bool _str_to_bool(value: str)
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean value based on common true indicators.

methods.name: str get_database_url()
methods.description: Retrieves the database URL from environment variables, raising an error if not set.

methods.name: bool get_sql_echo()
methods.description: Returns a boolean indicating whether SQL statements should be echoed, based on environment variable.
